candidates.name: Dorra (Durra) Gas Field Export Pipeline (Saudi share)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Durra Gas Field Export Pipeline; Arash
values.StartLocation: Dorra (Durra) gas field central gathering platform (offshore Saudi-Kuwait Neutral Zone)
values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: Offshore gas/condensate export line carrying the Saudi share from the Dorra (Durra) field central gathering platform in the Saudi-Kuwait Partitioned Neutral Zone to the Al-Khafji onshore gas processing plant. Part of KJO Dorra development Package 2B (central gathering complex + export pipelines and cables), tender issued and bids submitted (June 2025) but not yet awarded. No published GIS route.

candidates.researcher_notes: NEW ROW — all three add-threshold legs met. (a) Sponsor: Al-Khafji Joint Operations (KJO), a JV of Aramco Gulf Operations Company (AGOC, Saudi Aramco) and Kuwait Gulf Oil Company (KGOC, KPC). (b) Endpoints: Dorra (Durra) gas field central gathering platform in the Saudi-Kuwait Partitioned Neutral Zone -> Al-Khafji onshore gas processing plant, Saudi Arabia. (c) Concrete step: EPC tenders for the Dorra offshore packages issued Aug 2024; bids submitted June 2025; Package 1 (7 jackets + intra-field lines) awarded to Larsen & Toubro Energy Hydrocarbon Oct 2025 (~$140-150m). The export line itself is Package 2B (central gathering complex + 'pipelines for gas and condensate transmission to each shareholder' + cables) — tendered and bid, but NOT yet awarded, so status = proposed. Corroboration: >=2 independent outlets (MEED and Times Kuwait, plus NS Energy Business background) — HIGH tier for existence/sponsor/endpoints/status. CAPACITY LEFT BLANK: the 632 mmcf/d figure is contested across sources (some attribute it to the Kuwait-side facility near the Al-Zour refinery, others to the Saudi Khafji plant); field target ~1 bcf/d shared equally implies ~500 mmcf/d Saudi share, but that is an inference — not staged to avoid a wrong value. Length/diameter unknown (no published specs for the offshore export line) — left blank. Route: offshore, no published GIS -> 'no route'; endpoints known so RouteType 'Not mapped (but could be)'. NOT a match to existing rows: P5854 Wafra-Station 171 is an onshore Wafra (different Neutral Zone field) proposed line; P2702 Khafji crude is oil; and separately GGIT P5858 'Khafji Gas Pipeline' is an existing OPERATING 10 km / 40 MMcf/d line from the Khafji OIL field (KPC, Kuwait tab, 2021), a distinct entity from this proposed Dorra export line. Owner entity 'Al-Khafji Joint Operations (KJO)' returns no close existing gas entity (stage as new); AGOC ties to existing 'Aramco' parent.

candidates.name: Jafurah Gas Plant Export Pipeline (Package 5)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Jafurah Gas Field Development Phase 1 Package 5 Export Pipelines; Jafurah Gas Plant Package 5 Export Pipeline
values.RouteNotes: New-build ~349 km sales-gas export line from the Jafurah Gas Plant (Al Harmaliyah area, Eastern Province) tying into the Master Gas System / national grid; no official GIS route located, endpoint node into MGS not yet confirmed.

candidates.researcher_notes: MATCH-TO-EXISTING re-checked: no existing GEM Saudi gas row named Jafurah (65 SA gas rows reviewed). Should NOT fold into P5885 (MGS III Gas Pipelines, segments P6717-P6737) -- that is the separate Master Gas System Phase III program; this is a distinct EPC package (Package 5) under Saudi Aramco's Jafurah Gas Field Development Phase 1, a ~349 km sales-gas EXPORT line from the Jafurah Gas Plant into the national grid/MGS. ADD-THRESHOLD met on all three legs: (a) sponsor = Saudi Aramco (dmsprojects, protenders); (b) country + start endpoint = Jafurah Gas Plant, Al Harmaliyah / Eastern Province (metenders, protenders); (c) concrete step = EPC contract awarded July 2024 as part of Aramco's $25bn Jafurah/MGS III awards (saudigulfprojects, metenders). STATUS operating: Jafurah Phase 1 came onstream Dec 2025 at ~450 MMcf/d sales gas (Argus, JPT/SPE), and dmsprojects lists Package 5 Export Pipelines as 'Completed' -- the export line must be carrying that Phase 1 sales gas. CONFIDENCE: existence + sponsor + operating status are HIGH (independent: Aramco program coverage via Argus and JPT/SPE, plus multiple project DBs). The 349 km LENGTH is medium -- it appears only in tender/project-tracking databases (metenders/dmsprojects/protenders/bncnetwork) that may share a common tender origin, so treat as single-tier pending a second truly independent figure. Diameter and pipeline design capacity NOT found -> left blank (450 MMcf/d is plant output, not a verified pipeline rating; not entered). ROUTE: no official GIS located; corridor Jafurah plant (Eastern Province) -> MGS/national grid; specific MGS tie-in node unconfirmed, so End location left blank and RouteType/RouteAccuracy left blank (no fabricated coords). Aramco.com $25bn contract-awards page repeatedly timed out in url_verifier and is therefore NOT cited. Saudi Aramco entity already exists in the gas tracker (entity_lookup: 'Aramco'/'Saudi Aramco' 100% match) -- no new entity created.

candidates.name: Midyan Gas Plant–Duba Sales Gas Pipeline

values.PipelineName: Midyan Gas Plant–Duba Sales Gas Pipeline
values.OtherEnglishNames: Midyan–Duba Sales Gas Line; Midyan–Green Duba gas pipeline
values.EndLocation: Green Duba power station (near al-Muwaylih, Duba)
values.RouteNotes: No official GIS route located. NW Saudi Arabia (Tabuk region): Midyan gas plant ~135 km north of Duba, ~195 km west of Tabuk; sales-gas line runs south to the Green Duba (~570 MW) power station near al-Muwaylih. One of two parallel lines (this row = sales-gas line only; the parallel hydrocarbon-liquids/condensate line is out of GGIT scope). No coordinates fabricated.

candidates.researcher_notes:
NEW_ROW. Re-checked against all 65 existing SA gas rows in discovery_context.json: every one is Eastern Province / East-West / MGS III / central-region; there is no NW / Red Sea / Tabuk gas row, so this is NOT an existing GEM row under another name. Add-threshold met on all three legs and then some: (a) sponsor = Saudi Aramco (existing entity, entity_lookup matched 'Saudi Aramco'/'Aramco' 100 — no new entity); (b) endpoints = Midyan gas plant → Green Duba power station, Tabuk region NW Saudi Arabia; (c) concrete step far past threshold — EPC awarded to Larsen & Toubro, construction from 2013 (86% complete Oct 2016), OPERATING since 2017 delivering non-associated sales gas to SEC's ~570 MW Green Duba plant (replacing diesel).

Confidence: HIGH on existence, sponsor, endpoints, status — corroborated by ≥3 independent sources (Oil & Gas Journal trade press; Offshore-Technology project profile; Saudipedia national encyclopedia; also surfaced in Arab News / Saudi Gazette / Gulf Times / Business Standard reporting the L&T award). These are independent originations, not one reprinted wire.

Length: MEDIUM — genuine source conflict. Saudipedia and OGJ both give TWO ~98 km parallel lines; Offshore-Technology gives TWO ~84 km parallel lines. Filled LengthKnown=98 (2-source agreement) but 84 km is a credible alternative; flag for reviewer. Diameter: unknown, left blank (no orphan). Capacity: left blank on purpose — the widely cited 75 MMscf/d is the PLANT gas-processing capacity, not a stated pipeline throughput; not conflated into the Capacity field.

Scope: this row is the sales-gas line ONLY. The parallel line carries stabilized hydrocarbon liquids/condensate (~4,500 b/d) and belongs to GOIT, not GGIT — excluded here per consolidator note. ProposalYear=2013 from construction start / L&T EPC award year. No route in the routes repo; RouteAccuracy=approximate, corridor described in RouteNotes, no coordinates fabricated.
